$comment: Merged empirical era checklist for the DÖE eForms-DE 1.0/1.1/1.2 national dialect (ADR-0002 amendment, ADR-0004). eForms-DE 1.x shipped no SDK-DE fields.json artifact (issue 75: the SDK-eForms-DE fork on gitlab.opencode.de starts at national 2.0; the 1.x line on projekte.kosit.org is spec+schematron only), so the mappable universe is the full observed inventory: every element path in every eforms-de-1.x notice of the DÖE archive 2023-10..2026-07 (218876 notices: 1.0=31, 1.1=145859, 1.2=72986; scan de1x-scan.json, scripts de1x_scan.py + de1x_gen.py). Field ids are the source's own element names (DE1- prefix, extension plumbing elided); types are derived from naming conventions and observed listName/currencyID/unitCode attributes, cross-checked against sampled text. Merged (not per-minor): 686/773 paths are common to 1.1 and 1.2 and a superset only over-claims, never under-claims. A path outside this inventory quarantines the notice (ADR-0004); extending it is a reviewed edit + reprocess. EU base: DE-1.1~SDK 1.7, DE-1.2~SDK 1.8/1.9. Being empirical + predicate-free, this is independent of the xpath //+or grammar gap (issue 74).
